title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Position Is Still Open
description: Rhonda forecasts each sign's career doom as calm cosmic fact. Ronnie tries to spin every prediction into a promotion. There is a position open, and it keeps getting closer.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars. <p:0.3> With Rhonda.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Good evening. The market is cosmic, the hours are eternal, and a position has opened.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A position! See, that's good news, that's an opportunity. Who's hiring?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. You reply-all with the confidence of a founder. <p:0.3> The position is open. It is open for you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: For me? I mean, for them. That's a promotion, Aries, lean in.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Virgo. Your five year plan is reviewed by forces older than the company. They have notes. <p:0.3> Your name is already on the door. In pencil. Lightly.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [question-en] Pencil. <p:0.3> Pencil is, that's not permanent, is it.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Capricorn. You climb the ladder all night. At the top is a slightly higher ladder. The position is open above that one too.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, every sign keeps landing on this open position. Rhonda. <p:0.3> When do I read MY sign?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Now, Ronnie. The position we have forecast all night is yours. It is open because the stars have accepted your resignation.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: My resignation?! I didn't... <p:0.3> okay. Okay. So when does it start?
